justified_tb_changes.reason: Original reset task released reset after a falling edge, then tick waited for the following falling edge. The intervening rising edge sampled stale stimulus without updating the oracle, causing the initial mismatch. Release now occurs just after the reset-held rising edge so the next tick drives before the next active edge. Expected values and coverage were unchanged.
